kind: gen_input (VASP input set + five frozen-phonon displaced structures, two-step optics per geometry)
provenance: rubric, structure references, and reference_submission decks from 3_reproduction/L10/ (hpc_computations/deck_12x12 as-run INCAR.scf/INCAR.opt/KPOINTS_scf/KPOINTS_opt; auditor/deck/<u>/POSCAR displaced cells; run_manifest.md). See ../../../3_reproduction/L10/index.md.
reference_provenance: reference/<geom>/POSCAR symlinks our as-run displaced cell (auditor/deck/<geom>/POSCAR, generated from L9/hpc_computations/relax_ref/CONTCAR + L9/a1p_mode.json eigenvector_cartesian_normalized x amplitude). The grader matches each submitted POSCAR (both the _scf and _opt label of a geometry) against reference/<geom>/POSCAR.

structure_match.note: TIGHTENED per-task threshold (structure standard 2(5)/3(5) exception): the physical displacements are 0.010-0.020 A, so the default 0.1 A max-displacement cannot resolve them (it would pass an undisplaced or wrong-amplitude cell). 0.002 A resolves every designed-wrong variant (undisplaced, wrong amplitude, wrong sign pairing, displaced Ru) while giving ~5x margin below the smallest real displacement difference (0.010 A) and ~100x above POSCAR write precision. method='fallback' is REQUIRED: the cell is strongly anisotropic (a~3.5 A vs c=20 A) and the displacement is along c, so StructureMatcher's mean-length-normalized stol would be far too loose along the long axis; the fallback reports the true Cartesian max displacement in A. Verified in notes.md self-check.

encut_floor_note: 1.0 * max(ENMAX over Ru_pv 230.429, Cl 280.000) = 280.0 eV (the pseudopotential's own floor), read from the graderlib species catalog.

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

ldau.note: Paper specifies U=2 eV; our reproduced model uses Dudarev on Ru 4d. Effective LDAUTYPE=2, Ru LDAUL=2, finite LDAUU[Ru]-LDAUJ[Ru] in [1.9,2.1] eV; missing J defaults to zero. Per-species arrays follow POSCAR. Cl interaction values are not separately inspected.

magmom.note: Out-of-plane ferromagnetic seed (paper: FM, out-of-plane magnetization). Graded: SAXIS effective (0,0,1) (VASP default, so omit passes); noncollinear MAGMOM with Ru z-component |m_z| >= 1.0 and |m_z| >= |m_x|,|m_y| (out-of-plane dominant, magnitude and +/- sign free -- the sign is a TR-twin convention); each Cl |m| <= 0.5. A non-default-SAXIS compensated seed is a rare alternative consciously not accommodated (notes.md).

nbands_opt_note: NBANDS_opt>=48 retained. Empty-band truncation of existing matrix data supports the selected observables; it does not certify convergence of every newly executed optics run. Production requested 128 bands and stored 129 after code padding.

incar_required.note: Each rule is on the effective value (explicit if set, else the VASP default). Only these settings are graded; the per-tag triage and VASP defaults are in notes.md. 'common' = graded on all 10 labels; 'opt_only' = the 5 _opt labels; 'scf_only' = the 5 _scf labels.

common.static: NSW effectively 0 (default 0) or IBRION=-1 -- frozen-phonon, no ionic motion
common.LSORBIT: LSORBIT=.TRUE. (spin-orbit coupling; the valley Zeeman split is the whole observable; default .FALSE.)
common.LDAU_block: LDAU true, effective LDAUTYPE=2, Ru l=2 and finite U-J in [1.9,2.1] eV; omitted J=0; Cl values ungraded.
common.LASPH: LASPH=.TRUE. (open Ru-d shell + DFT+U aspherical PAW terms; default .FALSE.)
common.LMAXMIX: LMAXMIX>=4 for the task-defined d-channel SCF-to-fixed-density optics handoff.
common.kmesh: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.

opt_only.LOPTICS: LOPTICS=.TRUE. (writes the WAVEDER optical matrix elements; default .FALSE.)
opt_only.ICHARG: ICHARG=11 (non-self-consistent: read the fixed step-(a) charge density; default depends on ISTART)
opt_only.NBANDS: NBANDS>=48; retained empty-band floor, with evidence limits described in nbands_opt_note.

scf_only.LCHARG: LCHARG=.TRUE. (write the charge density for the step-(b) ICHARG=11 optics NSCF; VASP default .TRUE., so omit passes; LCHARG=.FALSE. fails)
scf_only.self_consistent_charge: ICHARG omitted or 0,1,2,4,5; charge updating required. No startup-file or restart-source check.

score: 1 only if all 10 runs pass: the displaced-structure match (both labels of each geometry) AND the applicable INCAR/KPOINTS REQUIRED rubric (common on all 10; opt_only on the 5 _opt; scf_only on the 5 _scf). Any single failure scores 0 (binary all-primary-pass).

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
